ENAR WELD-BRAZE PRIVATE LIMITED ... OFFICE #520, AI ATTAR BUSINESS CENTER AI BARSHA DUBAI, UAE'. Counter: page header states 'Total Shipments 308 Records detected' and 'Trading Partners 4 Known counterparties'; rows actually rendered on the free view = 5 shipment rows (all inbound/import) + 4 buyer rows + 5 supplier rows. No export B/L number, export date or export HS code is exposed on the free view — the 5 visible B/Ls (7139332, 6761737, 6539129, 9154579, 8998557) are all IMPORT records into India (PATPARGANJ ICD, MUNDRA SEA, JNPT), latest 2026-01-27.
domestic_evidence: No GST turnover band, GeM/CPPP tender award or annual-report domestic split could be retrieved: thecompanycheck.com and trademo.com returned HTTP 403, eximpedia.app returned HTTP 403, volza.com returned HTTP 403, and the DuckDuckGo search backend was unavailable ('searx: <urlopen error [Errno 111] Connection refused>') on both attempts, so no domestic-supply page was reachable. Only indirect signal: ImportKey shows the company importing welding consumables (e.g. '2025-11-08 | KISWEL LIMITED | ENAR WELD-BRAZE PRIVATE LIMITED | FLUX CORED WELDING WIRE K-309LF 1.2MM X 12.5KG SPOOL | KOREA REP OF | PATPARGANJ ICD | 83112000 | BOL 8998557'), which implies an Indian distribution business, but that is inference, not a supply record.
note: Legal entity exists and is active in customs data: 'ENAR WELD-BRAZE PRIVATE LIMITED, ENAR HOUSE E-164, EAST OF KAILASH' (Delhi). Export side is genuinely evidenced — the company appears as supplier of record to buyers in Kuwait (Prime Line Company for Wholesale), Mexico (Flota Mex S.A. de C.V.) and UAE (International Tools Welding Supply, Dubai) — but the free view exposes no export B/L number, date or destination HS code, so export_status is confirmed on counterparty evidence only, with per-shipment dates/HS null. Declared HS 831110 (coated electrodes of base metal) is consistent with the observed product mix: the company trades welding wire under 83112000, 72292000 and 81089090/81019990 (titanium and thoriated tungsten electrodes), so 831110 is plausible but not proven for any single shipment. Note one anomalous import line — '2025-11-19 | YIWU DHAKING IMP & EXP CO LIMITED | ENAR WELD-BRAZE PRIVATE LIMITED | HAIR CLIP (4887 KGS) | TIANJIN | JNPT NHAVA SHEVA SEA | 96151900 | BOL 9154579' — unrelated to welding; flag for review, do not treat as HS mismatch. Revenue and export volume: null, not public on any reachable source. Domestic supply: no GST band or tender record obtained because all registry/aggregator sources were blocked (403) and search was down — recorded as declared_only, not as 'no traces', since the failure is access-side, not evidence-side.
